sources.entry: dbdiagram.io - It's an online AI-Powered database diagram design tool that allows you to visually create and edit database schemas #free

summary.name: dbdiagram.io
summary.one_liner: dbdiagram.io is an online database diagram tool where you draw ER diagrams by writing DBML code.
use_cases: creating mock databases to test SQL queries
summary.what_it_does: The page presents dbdiagram as a tool for drawing ER diagrams by writing code, aimed at developers and data analysts. It is built around DBML, an open-source language for defining and documenting database schemas. The site also lists related products: dbdocs for web-based database documentation from code, RunSQL for quickly creating mock database environments to validate SQL queries, and Holistics.io for defining BI reports and metrics as code with Git version control. The page text gives no further detail on editing features or exports.
notable: Diagrams are created by writing DBML code
DBML is an open-source database definition language
Suite includes dbdocs, RunSQL and Holistics.io
caveats: Page text does not state limits on the free tier
Holistics.io is a separate BI product and is not covered in detail
